mapper.select: select cat.*, (select count(1) from video_platform_catalog sub where sub.parent_id = cat.id and sub.del_flag = '0') as childrenCount from video_platform_catalog cat where cat.del_flag = '0' and cat.id = #{id}

select cat.id as channelId, cat.name as name, cat.civil_code as civilCode, cat.business_group_id as businessGroupId, '1' as parental, '2' as channelType, cat.parent_id as parentId from video_platform_catalog cat where cat.del_flag = '0' and cat.platform_id = #{serverGbId}
